scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the coefficient sum a_j at the agent's reported kTc using the paper's formulas and scores by the residual |sum a_j - 1|, directly verifying the defining equation.

outputs.description: Six upper bound critical temperature values (kTc/J) for honeycomb, square, cubic lattices at D=0 and D=∞.

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute the values; the hidden gold reference values are the paper's reported numbers. The checker will compare each reported kTc_over_J to the hidden gold with an appropriate tolerance.

steps.description: Recompute the lattice-specific coefficient sum at each reported kTc and score by the residual |sum a_j - 1|.
